extension.description: This module will help you scrape YouTube without the official YouTube API and without selenium.
extension.news:
[B]2.8.2[/B] - Fix 'type str is not subscriptable' TypeError on minimal environments / Kodi Python by importing Literal from standard typing first and providing a safe subscriptable fallback when missing
[B]2.8.1[/B] - Fix playlist search (results_type='playlist'): parse current lockupViewModel playlist nodes (contentType LOCKUP_CONTENT_TYPE_PLAYLIST, id in contentId) with title/thumbnail/channel enrichment; get_videos_items yields them for the playlistRenderer selector
[B]2.8.0[/B] - Sync core with merged upstream (peoyli + ahai72160 fixes for YouTube layout changes) - Wrapper hardened for new lockupViewModel/shorts shapes (tolerant title/thumbnail/duration) - Fixed get_channel positional-arg and list_playlists get_videos arity bugs - duration_converter handles H:MM:SS, live and missing durations - Optional login cookies on all core calls and wrapper list_* helpers, for own/private videos - Authenticated youtubei continuations via SAPISIDHASH headers - Parse logged-in page layout (yt-initial-data script tag)
[B]2.6.0[/B] - Updated to last upstream version (2.6.0)
[B]2.5.1[/B] - Bump to 2.5.1 version including all commits adapted for older Kodi versions
[B]2.3.1.X[/B] - Some fixes brought from upstream - Removed is_py3 as it was not used
[B]2.2.2.X[/B] Copied from upstream (version 2.2.2): https://github.com/dermasmid/scrapetube Changes made: 1) Backported to work on Python 2.7 2) Added list formation module to help get videos in a more simple way for Kodi development 3) Updated user agent string to Firefox/Windows (version 101)
